cohort: 330 patients referred from peripheral care centers to a tertiary care center in the first 24 hours after delivery due to complications
finding: Complicated cesarean sections and vaginal deliveries had similar maternal outcomes in the early follow-up period, except for a higher requirement of hysterectomy and relaparotomy in the cesarean section group.
mod_finding: Complicated cesarean sections were associated with a significantly higher requirement for hysterectomy and relaparotomy compared to complicated vaginal deliveries.
